# IConfigurationManagerEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/config-contracts/src/events/IConfigurationManagerEvents.sol)

**Title:**
IConfigurationManagerEvents

Interface for events emitted by the Configuration Manager


## Events
### RaftUpdated
Emitted when the Raft address is updated


```solidity
event RaftUpdated(address oldRaft, address newRaft);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`oldRaft`|`address`||
|`newRaft`|`address`|The address of the new Raft|
